top_claims.claim: PotlatchDeltic was a 2.1-million-acre timber REIT with mills and a rural land sale option. FY2024 CAD of ~$0.85 per share did not cover the $1.80 dividend; ~$1.0 billion long-term debt and a lumber-cycle trough weighed on per-share owner cash. At the last standalone price of $39.25, our base case annual return is -9.95
At **$39.25** per share, we expect about **-9.95%** per year over **7 years** on the base case (normalized owner cash of **$0.85** per share).
*Primary risk: Standalone owner cash (CAD ~$0.85/sh) remained below the $1.80 dividend through a lumber trough, forcing debt reliance or asset sales to maintain REIT payout optics.

Inversion: If post-merger Rayonier harvest synergies and a normalized lumber cycle lift combined CAD per RYN share above the pro-forma dividend, the merged entity could compound despite weak standalone PCH math at $39.25.
